item.title: Disability Standards for Education expanded to include most ECEC services
item.description: From 1 August 2026, most early childhood education and care (ECEC) services across Australia will be formally covered by the Disability Standards for Education 2005, marking an important step in strengthening inclusive education from the earliest years.
